title: Creatio Partners with Innowise to Accelerate AI-Native CRM and Workflow Automation Across Industries
summary: The partnership helps organizations accelerate AI adoption and transform customer operations with AI-native CRM and workflow automation
body_markdown:
Creatio, an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together — with no limits on users, agents, or scale, today announced a new partnership with Innowise, a global IT consulting and software development company.


The partnership brings together Creatio’s AI-native CRM and workflow automation platform with Innowise’s expertise in software engineering, AI, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and enterprise modernization. Together, the companies will enable organizations to streamline processes, increase operational efficiency, and accelerate business outcomes by embedding AI into everyday work.


With nearly two decades of software engineering and consulting experience, Innowise helps organizations solve complex business challenges through tailored technology solutions. As a Creatio partner, the company will support customers in adopting AI-native CRM and workflow automation across sales, marketing, customer service, and core business operations.


“We are excited to partner with Creatio and bring its AI-native platform to our clients,” says Dmitry Nazaverich, Chief Technology Officer. “This partnership strengthens our ability to help organizations automate key processes, improve operational efficiency, and drive business growth.”


Creatio is an AI-native CRM and workflow platform built for the AI era. Through its Unlimited Enterprise operating model, organizations can scale execution freely across teams, AI agents, and operations without the constraints of traditional enterprise software. Creatio combines CRM, industry workflows, AI-native capabilities, and no-code tools on one unified platform to help organizations automate processes, adapt faster, and continuously evolve how work gets done. Genuine care for customers and partners remains at the heart of Creatio’s approach to innovation. Creatio is recognized as a Leader and Strong Performer in multiple Gartner and Forrester reports, and its products consistently receive outstanding end-user reviews on peer-to-peer platforms.


“Innowise combines deep engineering expertise with a strong understanding of how technology can solve complex business challenges. This makes them a valuable addition to Creatio’s global partner ecosystem,” said Alex Donchuk, Senior Vice President, Global Channels at Creatio. “Together, we will help more organizations move beyond fragmented legacy technologies and embrace AI-native CRM and workflow automation to transform the way work gets done.”


**About Innowise**


Innowise is a global IT consulting and software development company founded in 2007. It helps organizations accelerate digital transformation through custom software solutions and engineering expertise. Its teams work across software development, AI and machine learning, cloud, data analytics, cybersecurity, DevOps, enterprise automation, and IT staff augmentation. With a practical, engineering-led approach and internationally recognized quality and security standards, Innowise supports startups, mid-sized businesses, and enterprises across industries worldwide. Its recent industry recognition includes a place in the Financial Times FT1000 ranking of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, CRN’s 2026 Solution Provider 500 and Tech Elite 250 lists, and the 2025 IAOP Global Outsourcing 100.


**About Creatio**


Creatio is an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together — with no limits on users, agents, or scale. We help midsize and large organizations run customer workflows in the AI era. Headquartered in Boston, MA, with a global team and a large ecosystem of partners, Creatio serves thousands of customers in over 100 countries and automates tens of millions of workflows daily. Genuine care for our clients and partners is at the heart of our DNA.
